name: Vhalgrim: Age of Ruin
storyline:
Long before the first kingdoms, the entity Vhaz'karoth waged war on creation, believing all life should return to primordial chaos. Unable to destroy him, the gods imprisoned him in the Primordial Abyss behind seven divine seals and erased their locations from history.

Centuries ago, a desperate priest named Eryndor, who had lost his family and village to an unknown disease, performed a forbidden ritual and received an answer from the Abyss. Transformed into the undying Mal'zaroth, Herald of Extinction, he was charged with spreading the Pestilence of the Abyss, weakening the seals, and preparing his master's return.

Now the dead have begun to walk again. Arriving in the city of Eldoria as the first infected rise, a new hero is drawn into the fight against the plague.
summary:
Vhalgrim: Age of Ruin is a free-to-play dark fantasy MMORPG about surviving a world overrun by an undead plague. Players choose one of five classes, each with three specializations, and shape their hero through a vast skill web while hunting monsters, clearing dungeons, and forging powerful gear across a persistent online world.

The game centers on guild rivalry and a world that keeps moving without the player. Guilds fight for regions and castles in weekly wars, while nightly infernal invasions, roaming world bosses, and a spreading pestilence put constant pressure on its cities and hunting grounds. Day, night, and weather follow the real-world conditions of São Paulo, Brazil.
